observations.finding: SelectedValidatedProfileV1 owns actual proof plus full LoaderProvenanceV1. AdoptionBodyV1 owns actual proof plus inline Option<LoaderProvenanceV1>. Every owner and provenance field is private; no Clone/default/parts/extraction/deserializer or flag/digest-selected mint API exists.

ordinary body sets selected=None. The sole selected adoption method consumes self, destructures the original proof/provenance owners, creates Some(provenance), and calls RuntimeControl::adopt_body. Borrow accessors return references tied by Rust lifetime elision to the borrowed owner.
AdoptedProof retains opaque body with original source/metadata reservation tickets. selected_provenance returns immutable Option<&LoaderProvenanceV1> borrowed from that body.

The existing ordinary adopt signature still accepts ValidatedSwiftReactor, SwiftRunBudget, Instant, Cancellation and returns Result<(Self,AdoptedProof),SwiftRunFailure>. It delegates immediately through ordinary(None) into the single adopt_body admission/cleanup implementation. Refusal drops body before proof-ticket refunds.
Successful proof cleanup consumes the actual AdoptedProof, drops its opaque body, then attempts both source and metadata refunds.
Loader module remains private; control remains crate-private. The selected carrier and opaque body have no public reexport.
